description: This file defines the NotesAdapter class for a RecyclerView, used to display a list of notes with their title, content preview, and last update time, in an Android app.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: A ListAdapter for displaying Note items within a RecyclerView, handling item diffing and click events.

classes.name: NotesAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to note item views (title, content preview, updated timestamp).

methods.name: Diff
methods.description: Object for calculating differences between note items to optimize RecyclerView updates.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the note item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds note data to the ViewHolder views for display, including formatting the date and handling click events.
